fato_historico: 1979: Eight people escape from East Germany to the west in a homemade hot air balloon.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite you to break free from self-imposed limitations, Cancer. Much like an adventurous soul drifting across borders in a handmade balloon to find a new dawn, you are encouraged to release heavy burdens. It is a good time to consider how your sensitivity can be your greatest lift, carrying you gracefully toward unexpected new heights.
frase_do_dia: The sky has no borders for a heart that dares to dream big.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of balance and new beginnings.
conselho: Trust your inner intuition and let your spirit drift toward freedom today.
